forge-events.adapter.description: Storage adapter behind the port: origin (Cursor Origin, D-283) or file (local append-only JSON Lines log). The default is origin since the ORIGIN-FINISH cut-over (Daniel 03/11 00:10 BRT); the GitHub adapter left the port (D-293).

forge-events.adjudicated_tiers.description: Gate tiers (explicit, derived by gate-hooks/tier.sh: --tier3 3, --pr 1, --sha without --pr 2) whose run adjudicates known base defects and reports them (the KD1 switch, GX-11, D-070). [1] restores the per-PR-only adjudication.

forge-events.attribution_url.description: The link of the attribution footer that scripts/pr-body writes at the end of every PR body (D-208).

forge-events.board_comment_max_chars.description: Maximum body size of one event-board comment; shared by the Origin board and its overflow store.

forge-events.board_issue.description: BOARD (CANALE2): the issue that holds the board (one comment per section of forge-events.board_sections, edited in place). 0: no board; the board kinds stay where forge-events.adapter puts them. Set once the issue exists.

forge-events.board_overflow_ref.description: BOARD (CANALE2): the branch under refs/heads/ that keeps the full text of a board section cut at the comment limit (create and fast-forward, D-070).

forge-events.board_sections.description: BOARD (CANALE2): each board section (section) and the event kinds it shows (kinds); these kinds go to the git-ref log and the board instead of a comment once forge-events.board_issue is set. The seven are the repeated state of the channel on 01/11 (79 % of #865).

forge-events.check_run_publisher.description: Who posts the gate's Origin check run (tower/gate). client: the Origin client with the session's credential, which Origin refuses unless it is an oit_ installation token. control: the control plane's POST /v1/check-run, which mints the installation token from the Origin app's key it alone holds (ORIGIN_APP_PRIVATE_KEY) and answers 503 while that secret is absent (D-299). port: the engine's port (POST /v1/check-run), posted by the live service on AWS with the app's key from Parameter Store (/tower/origin/factory-app-signing-key; CHECK-RUN-AWS), the Worker off the path.

forge-events.claim_tries.description: How many refused claim pushes scripts/decision-next --claim makes before it gives up (D-189).

forge-events.clock.description: Clock the port injects for occurred_at and step durations; tests inject a fake clock object instead.

forge-events.contracts_dir.description: Directory of the event envelope and payload JSON Schemas, relative to the repository root.

forge-events.contracts_lock.description: File in the contracts directory holding the sha256 of every locked schema; a locked schema never changes.

forge-events.control_token_env.description: CONTROL-CHANNEL (CANALE7): the environment variable that holds the control plane's events token (the Worker's EVENTS_TOKEN secret); the value is never read from a file or printed.

forge-events.envelope_schema.description: Envelope schema every emitted and read event is validated against.

forge-events.event_comment_marker.description: The event comment marker ignored by decision-wait scans.

forge-events.event_id_algorithm.description: Hash of producer, type and natural key that forms event_id (the idempotency key).

forge-events.file_kinds.description: GX-FIX-forge-rate (D-070): event kinds stored in the local file log (forge-events.local_log_dir) whatever forge-events.adapter is. High-volume measurement kinds (one per test or step) never become issue comments; a reader of the port sees both logs of a channel. GX-25: gate.started is file-routed too, because a gate run is already at its bound of GitHub writes (gate.forge_writes_per_run_max); one key moves it back to the forge.

forge-events.gate_producer.description: Producer name of the gate's events; part of every gate event id.

forge-events.gate_step_prefix.description: Prefix of the engine.step.measured step name for each gate stage (gate:<stage>).

forge-events.git_ref_attempts.description: EVENTS-REF (E1, D-273): fast-forward attempts of one append to the git-ref log before it fails; each attempt reads the tip again, so a rival's record is kept. Lost races only, never a refused transport.

forge-events.git_ref_log.description: EVENTS-REF (E1, D-273): the branch name under refs/heads/ that holds the event log's state kinds, one commit per append, written by create and fast-forward over git (forge_git_ref.GitRefAdapter). Shared by every channel; never deleted or rewound.

forge-events.git_ref_window.description: EVENTS-REF (E1, D-273): records (commits) of the git-ref log a windowed read covers (ForgeEvents.read_recent, D-085): the newest git_ref_window appends of every channel; a read of the whole log reads every commit.

forge-events.local_log_dir.description: Directory of the file adapter's append-only logs, relative to the repository root (gitignored).

forge-events.log_adapter.description: CONTROL-CHANNEL (CANALE7, D-282): the adapter that stores every event kind not routed elsewhere, when it differs from forge-events.adapter, which keeps the forge's other operations (change, merge, status). git-ref: the train/events branch on Origin (EVENTS-REF, D-273), the default for good since D-300 (VAZÃO F61, D-296 made permanent): the diary and the gate proof live there, never on Cloudflare. The control plane's /v1/events left the enum (D-300, SEMENTE §6: no double path). The GitHub adapter left the port (D-293).

forge-events.origin_check_suite_key.description: Stable check-suite key of the gate verdict. Required checks match the app plus this key.

forge-events.origin_check_suite_name.description: Display name of the gate's check suite. Matching uses the key, not this name.

forge-events.origin_status_map.description: Gate status to Origin check-run status and, when the run is finished, conclusion. A state with no row is refused.

forge-events.repo.description: Repository whose change and repository channels the port reads and writes by default.

forge-events.status_context_gate.description: Context name of the commit status the gate writes for a PR head.

forge-events.status_description_chars.description: Longest commit status description (GitHub cuts at 140).

forge-events.status_digest_chars.description: Characters of the verdict input_digest shown in the commit status description.

forge-events.status_enabled.description: Whether the gate writes its own commit status (GX-17); false turns it off without touching the verdict.

forge-events.subject_exempt_schemas.description: Payload schemas merged before the port that carry no subject or natural key (scripts/premises prints them, P1). The list only shrinks: each leaves when its v2 with the subject replaces it (expand->contract); the port refuses to emit them.

forge-events.subject_fields.description: Fields every payload schema must require so consumers always have the subject, unit and premises.

forge-events.tier1_gate_modes.description: Deprecated (GX-11, D-070): the gate tier is explicit (gate-hooks/tier.sh, D-B5) and the KD1 switch reads forge-events.adjudicated_tiers. These modes are only the fallback of scripts/lib/gate_tier.py when no tier was derived (a caller outside gate-local); gate_report still passes them in. It stays registered until a later revision removes it (GX-26; schema compat).
